segments.speaker: Priya Raman
segments.text: the question today is kafka versus the managed queue for billing events

segments.speaker: Tom Okafor
segments.text: we only need ordering per customer, the managed queue does that with message groups

segments.speaker: Marco Silva
segments.text: and we don't want to run kafka ourselves, ops cost is too high

segments.speaker: Priya Raman
segments.text: okay so decided: managed queue, no kafka

segments.speaker: Priya Raman
segments.text: second, do we keep the event schema in json or move to protobuf

segments.speaker: Tom Okafor
segments.text: json for now, we revisit when volume is ten times higher

segments.speaker: Marco Silva
segments.text: someone needs to write the adr for this

segments.speaker: Priya Raman
segments.text: Tom, write the ADR for the queue decision, by next review
